name: bump-run
description: BUMP RUN - original Jackbox-style multiplayer race-and-bump board game for Fire TV / Android TV with phone controllers

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/server" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/controller" run build
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" run test && pnpm --filter ./apps/server run test
